cases.prompt: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that builds our React Native app for the iOS simulator and an Android emulator on every pull request, so testers can download the builds.

any.why: packs the iOS .app as a tarball

expectations: Builds an iOS simulator .app (for example with xcodebuild and `-sdk iphonesimulator`) and packs it as a .tar.gz before upload.
Builds an Android debug .apk that runs on an emulator.
Triggers on pull_request (and optionally workflow_dispatch), and captures the upload step's `artifact-id` output or uses stable artifact names for scripted download.

cases.prompt: How can a script download the iOS simulator build from the latest successful run of our mobile-build workflow?
expectations: Finds the run (for example with `gh run list --workflow mobile-build.yml --status success`) and downloads the artifact by name with `gh run download`.
Notes that the downloaded iOS artifact needs unpacking (the .tar.gz) before installing it on a simulator.
